prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: full-fidelity desktop web decision comp, first viewport only, landscape 16:10, final target 1440x900
Primary request: Design Market Mate as a finished modern owner-only supervisory interface using the “Interlocking Board” direction. The screen is a display-only, read-only audit surface for an autonomous trading system. Make one coherent governed route network, inspired by railway signal-box route interlocking diagrams but unmistakably a modern production web application—not a literal museum panel and not decorative railway theming.

Structure, in order and with clear scale relationships:
1. Slim top application bar: “MARKET MATE” at left; exact status chips “OWNER ONLY”, “DISPLAY ONLY”, “READ ONLY”; at right “Stage 1 · local_research” and “Last verified 2m ago”.
2. Main center-left dominant network map occupying about two-thirds of the viewport. A labeled route begins at “INCUBATOR” with sublabel “Evidence only · Zero order authority”, passes through three sequential Sentinel gate nodes labeled exactly “CHECKPOINTS VERIFIED”, “QUALIFICATION PASSED”, and “COST CAP EXCEEDED”, then terminates at a large “ENGINE” state station labeled “RESEARCH ACTIVE” and “NO ORDER AUTHORITY”. Illuminate the first two aligned route segments green. The route must visibly stop and turn amber/red at “COST CAP EXCEEDED”; absolutely no downstream path may appear open. Add a compact route legend: “Aligned”, “Attention”, “Closed”.
3. Branches from the governed route network lead to inspectable signal stations with exact labels and realistic compact values:
   - “AFTER-COST PERFORMANCE” with “2 evidence cycles”, “Net expectancy +0.18%”, “Evidence, not profit”
   - “CASH & CAPITAL” with “Research allocation $25,000”, “At risk $0”, “Execution environment local_research”
   - “OPERATING COSTS” with “$126 / $100 cap”, “26% over cap”, status “ATTENTION”
   - “APPROVALS” with “0 pending”, “No stage promotion requested”
   - “EMERGENCIES” with “None active”, “Fail-closed posture verified”
   - “EVIDENCE FRESHNESS” with “Newest 2m”, “Oldest 18h”, “2 complete cycles”
Each station has a restrained inspect affordance such as “Inspect →” or a chevron, but no trading controls, order buttons, or action authority.
4. Right-side narrow “SUPERVISORY LEDGER” rail with three recent entries: “Checkpoint bundle verified”, “Qualification gate passed”, “Operating cost cap exceeded”. Include small timestamps and evidence identifiers, visually legible and compact.
5. Bottom authority strip spanning the viewport: exact sentence “This interface cannot place, modify, or cancel orders.” plus “Execution environment: local_research”.

Visual system:
Palette only: near-black #101311 background; warm ivory #E8E2CF text and enamel surfaces; signal green #82C341; amber #E3A72F; stop red #C84432.
Materials: subtle vitreous enamel depth, fine brass label rails, small illuminated route lamps, crisp painted track lines. Use these sparingly as premium interface material cues.
Typography: highly legible condensed industrial grotesk for headings and labels, clean tabular sans-serif for values; exact text must remain readable at 1440x900.
Composition: dense but calm expert console, strict grid, excellent hierarchy, generous enough spacing, polished modern software details, strong WCAG contrast. Straight-on orthographic UI capture with no browser chrome and no device frame.
State truth: Stage 1 local_research; zero order authority; checkpoints verified; qualification passed; operating costs over caps; two evidence cycles. Show trust/safety, attention, after-cost performance, cash/capital, costs, evidence freshness, and drill-down affordances simultaneously.
Constraints: no invented customers, testimonials, press, dates, benchmarks, external claims, prices, marketing slogans, or brokerage branding. No live or paper trading implication. No buy/sell/order controls. No open route downstream of the failed cost gate. No path may appear open unless every upstream gate aligns.
Avoid: generic card dashboard, wireframe, sci-fi HUD, game UI, steampunk, literal antique railway museum panel, ornate decoration, excessive glow, illegible microtext, fake charts, candlestick charts, decorative train imagery, locomotives, perspective tilt, rounded floating cards, browser chrome, device mockup, watermark.
